alias_splits.notes: Rust CLI help documents HCLI_HAWKING_BIN; Python native connector reads HCLI_HAWKING_BINARY; hide-backend supervisor reads HIDE_HAWKING_BIN. No compatibility alias between BIN and BINARY.

machine.py treats MEM_RESERVE_BYTES as bytes and RESERVE_GIB as GiB; first-hit wins. Dual unit is a footgun.
resolve_runtime_limits reads HCLI_RESIDENT_RUNTIME_LIMIT (plus unprefixed RESIDENT_RUNTIME_LIMIT). RuntimePool._admit then also mins against HCLI_MAX_RUNTIMES. Two knobs on overlapping width.

recommended_normalization.proposal: Keep the name. Make every getenv default 1800. Change autonomy_gate setdefault('180') to an explicit local timeout argument (or a distinctly named HCLI_AUTONOMY_GATE_TIMEOUT) so a gate cannot poison process env for later readers. Do not rename HCLI_MODEL_TIMEOUT.

recommended_normalization.action: Do not rename HCLI_SWAP_CEILING_GIB; keep the 2 GiB product fallback; stop treating 64 as a second default
recommended_normalization.proposal: Name stays. Product fallbacks already agree at 2 GiB (machine.py and resident.py). Tests may pin 64 for a packed host, but that pin must remain a test env assignment, not a second getenv default. Document in docs/RESIDENT_DAEMON.md that 2 is the default and 64 is a host-specific override.
recommended_normalization.rationale: docs/RESIDENT_DAEMON.md already names this variable. Renaming it would break every test and campaign that sets HCLI_SWAP_CEILING_GIB=64.

recommended_normalization.action: Alias HCLI_HAWKING_BINARY to HCLI_HAWKING_BIN (and the reverse)

First-hit chain: HCLI_HAWKING_BIN then HCLI_HAWKING_BINARY, one canonical internal name. Do not drop either string without an alias — BIN is operator-facing via `hcli serve` help.
recommended_normalization.rationale: Same concept, two names, no alias. An operator who follows rust help will not affect the Python native connector.

recommended_normalization.rationale: Externally meaningful leftover name. Deleting it without an alias would break anyone still exporting HAIDER_MODEL_PATH.
